key_insight: Multi-domain AAA-least squares (nAAALS) efficiently approximates harmonic functions across coupled interior and exterior domains, enabling simulations of interacting vortex patches.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a low-cost computational approach for coupled boundary problems in inviscid fluid dynamics and potentially other engineering fields.
method: Use AAA rational approximation of boundary conjugate data to place poles according to local geometry and global domain configuration.
Extend least-squares fitting to enforce coupled matching conditions across multiple boundaries.
Couple nAAALS with standard Runge–Kutta schemes to evolve domain boundaries.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports reproduction of known vortex patch equilibria and evolution of equilibrium-displaced configurations, with accurate results computed in seconds on a standard laptop.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantified error or scaling benchmarks, and vortex-patch demonstrations do not establish applicability to general turbulent flows.
paper_title: Multi-domain AAA-least squares methods and applications
